_doc: Hard-coded font sizes that intentionally do NOT follow the Font Size setting. Every other text size in web-app/src (outside src/mobile) must scale with --ui-font-base. Read by scripts/codemods/scale-font-sizes.mjs and src/__tests__/fixedFontSizes.guard.test.ts. Each entry: file (relative to web-app), token (the exact class or declaration), reason.

entries.reason: Favicon fallback letter drawn inside a fixed size-3.5/size-4 circle; scaling the glyph without the circle would overflow it.
Favicon fallback letter drawn inside a fixed size-4 circle; scaling the glyph without the circle would overflow it.
Touch-only devices: iOS zooms into any focused field under 16px, so this floor must stay a literal 16px.
